comment: The panel prints Clock, Reset, Entropy, High-E, Low-E, Neg-E, Mode and Chan; the nine signal jacks on each side carry no lettering. The three CV jacks each carry the maker's second line 'Expects a 0-10V signal'. The mode CV maps 0V to 10V onto the six modes by multiplying by 0.6 and rounding (src/randrouter.cpp:535), and the entropy CV onto the three settings by multiplying by 0.3 (src/randrouter.cpp:542); the channels CV is a plain threshold at 5V (src/randrouter.cpp:528). With trigger mode enabled those same three jacks are read as triggers instead. No family is written for the nine signal inputs or the nine outputs: the module routes whatever it is given and gives the voltage no meaning of its own. The eighteen rule names in the lines are the maker's, from the table in README.md.
